name: an-indented-workshop-example-declares-nothing
description: The second Markdown way to mark an example is INDENTATION, and it is refused by the same rule as a fence: a ratified list line starts at column 0, so an indented 'workshop:' example declares nothing, the write is denied as if no section existed, and the ignored lines are named on stderr rather than silently absorbed.
